# Project Monet

Canonical website: https://www.projectmonet.com
Contact: contact@projectmonet.com
Websites service: https://www.projectmonet.space

ProjectMonet.com is the Social-first, Instagram-only website for Project Monet. It explains creator-led Instagram strategy, content, profile/funnel optimization, management, measurement, the Funnel-First Growth System, a qualified Viral Mandate, and the Free Social Presence Audit.

## Core methodology

Funnel-First Growth System: Positioning → TOFU → MOFU → BOFU → Publish → Protect Signal → Measure → Iterate → Report Against Baseline.

Core philosophy: Build the machine before pouring traffic into it.

## Proof rules

- 35M+ organic views, 102K+ combined followers, and 5+ originated trend formats are founder/creator credentials, not Project Monet client outcomes.
- Founder/creator, team/collaborator, Project Monet client, and speculative/concept proof must remain separately labelled.
- No client, testimonial, revenue, lead, follower, virality or other result should be inferred unless it is explicitly published with evidence and correct attribution.
- Results That Speak is intentionally unpopulated in V1 pending owner-approved reels and verified metrics.

## Free Social Presence Audit

The audit is free and concise. It may cover positioning, recent content patterns, conversion/trust issues, category observations, three high-impact opportunities and a next-step recommendation. It is not a full strategy, content calendar, script library or performance promise. Requests are qualification-based.

## Viral Mandate

Viral Mandate is a potential qualified mode where more performance risk requires more creative control inside approved brand, factual, legal and safety guardrails. Not every account qualifies. Exact thresholds, baseline formula, contract length, guarantee clock, exclusions and remedies are not publicly locked and must not be inferred.

## Public routes

- / — Social-first homepage
- /audit — Free Social Presence Audit request
- /viral-mandate — high-level public explanation
- /work — proof classifications and reel architecture
- /about — creator-led origin and credentials
- /contact — Social enquiry contact
- /privacy — current data handling and Web3Forms retention
- /cookies — optional analytics consent
- /terms — website terms and no-guarantee boundaries
- /audit-terms — audit scope and eligibility

No pricing or package tiers are public in V1. Project Monet does not publish a phone number on this site.
